regime_context: The US thematic detector shows Memory, HBM & Storage as the top-ranked narrative, but with fading momentum, mixed trend health, and moderate breadth. Broad rotation (67% eligible) and low absorption indicate no dominant one-narrative structure. The absolute-trend gate—the detector's only validated edge—remains active for eligible themes, supporting trend-following discipline for risk control. Given the poor past track record (0.2 directional accuracy), all convictions are low.
emerging_watch: Watch Cybersecurity as a potential new dominant narrative if its rank score overtakes Memory, HBM & Storage with sustained high breadth and durability; kill if Memory regains a decisive score margin or Cybersecurity becomes ineligible. This is a watch, not a call.

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: The theme passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible), shows a strong trend (hurst_tag: trend) with high durability (0.74) and broad participation (breadth 0.86), and is not crowded. The trend discipline suggests staying with this theme to control drawdown risk.
theses.dissent: Energy could be sensitive to an unexpected global demand slowdown or escalating geopolitics that disrupt flows, which the trend gate would not foresee.

falsifier.text: The theme becomes ineligible (trend gate fails) or durability drops below 0.6 and breadth collapses below 0.5.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is eligible, exhibiting a strong durable trend (durability 0.84, hurst_tag 'trend') with high breadth (0.8). It is crowded (crowding_z=1.9), which is a sizing caution only, not a fade—the absolute-trend gate supports staying overweight to avoid drawdowns.
theses.dissent: Crowding could lead to sharp, sudden reversals if the consensus trade unwinds, but fading the leader on crowding alone is the documented failure mode.

falsifier.text: It loses eligibility (trend gate broken) or durability falls below 0.6 and breadth narrows significantly.

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Although eligible, AI Semiconductors has modest durability (0.63), mixed trend health (hurst_tag 'mixed'), and limited breadth (0.25). The trend discipline warrants a cautious underweight relative to the broader benchmark to control potential drawdowns.
theses.dissent: A resurgence in AI capex or positive memory/HBM spillover could quickly broaden participation and reignite the trend.

falsifier.text: Breadth expands above 0.5 and durability rises above 0.7, or the theme becomes crowded without losing eligibility.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
